title.en: MALACANAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE ATTACHMENT OF THE COMMISSION ON INDIGENOUS PEOPLES FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT TO THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT

text.en:
Attachment. The NCIP is hereby placed under the administrative
supervision of the OP.

Repeal. EO No. 67 is hereby amended. All other orders, rules and
regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of October
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Four.
)
By the President:
KUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Executive Secretary
Office of the President
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
CERTIFIED COPY
V. TOLENTINO-NAVA
MERIZZ24 ACTING DIRECTOR IV
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
